items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the compatibility between the divisor of a meromorphic section and the divisor of the corresponding rational function on the trivialising torsor at source lines 2476-2489, label lemma-Gm-torsor-divisor-meromorphic-section, whose proof occupies source lines 2491-2550. The proof is a coefficient comparison that first identifies which divisors can contribute: a prime divisor of the torsor either dominates the base, in which case both coefficients vanish, or is the preimage of a prime divisor of the base. In the remaining case the coefficient is written as a difference of lengths over the henselizations of the local rings at the generic points, and the two sides are matched using flatness of the map of henselizations together with the identification of the maximal ideal obtained from the structure of the torsor. The counted statement records neither the classification of divisors nor the length comparison.
